Hello everyone. Today I thought I would share one of my favorite games to play on the Game Gear.

Halley Wars is a shmup that is only available for the Famicom Disk and the Game Gear. Both versions are very different from one another in almost everything but name. You can look at gameplay for the Game Gear version here.

The gameplay is slower for a shooter, but do not let that fool you. This game does get very challenging in later levels.There are many power ups for you to collect while blasting through enemies. Most of the power ups will increase the power of your main gun, while the others usually give you two missiles to use. The last power up I can think of is a shield which is self explanatory.

The graphics for the game are really nice. There are a lot of colors to look at and the sprites are very well made. Each level does have a feeling of sameness though which could get repetitive for some people. The playing field is quite small for your average shooter, which does add a new level of challenge to work with. The music for this game is really nice as well. It has a very future and exploration vibe to it, while still making you feel tense in later levels.

If you don't have this for the system and you are a fan of shmups, then I can easily recommend this one.
